description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Iraxxa trigger, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
